## What's Changed
* Add Show in Finder to file tree folders by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/506
* Add experimental Note peek (#508) [Release] by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/508
* Remove classic All Notes grid by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/509
* Add heading-level wiki links with autocomplete and scroll by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/511
* Add default folder for new notes by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/512
* Improve connections graph controls and search by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/513
* Add Grok Build CLI as an Agents provider by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/514
* Add formatting bar visibility setting (#515) [Release] by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/515
* Align side peek with workspace edges by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/517
* Cut RAM from inline images, closed AI panel, and graph cache by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/519


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/compare/v0.8.14...v0.8.15
